When an article is tagged with the [[Template:cleanup]] tag, it means that someone has spotted something wrong with the article, but was unable/unwilling to take care of it at the time. The tag allows all such articles to be collected in [[:Category:Cleanup]], so if you are looking for something to do, you can start there!

Some common types of tasks to be cleaned up follow, together with advice on how to handle them.

* '''Harmful content''': Nonsense, personal essays/opinions in inappropriate places, accuracy problems, or severe unedited bias: may be fixed by paring down content until nothing objectionable remains. Also, you may choose to move the information to an article or [[Help:Sections|section]] of the article where it makes more sense, in the case of rampant fan speculation/opinion.

* '''Unrelated articles/pages/images''': Take the issue to [[project:Pages for deletion]] if it is borderline, otherwise contact one of the [[project:Administrators|Administrators]] to get them to delete the offending page.  If it isn't deleted it will generally be moved back here, hopefully already somewhat improved.   

* '''Poor quality article/page''': '''[[project:Be bold|Be bold]]'''; try to improve it!  Cleanup can be hard work, but the end result is a vastly improved wiki and a better experience for both readers and editors.

* '''Raw text dump''': No [[m:Help:link|wikilinks]] or [[Help:How to edit a page#wiki markup|wiki markup]] - remove ''only after'' the article has been wikified, reworded with better style, verified for accuracy, weeded for useless or unremarkable information, and checked for [[project:Copyrights|copyright]] violations. 

* '''Expansion of a [[:Category:Stubs|stub]] article''': Most requests of this sort can be improved on within a short time frame, and other editors can help later if you lack sufficient expertise to improve that particular article significantly.

* '''Long-term reworking, completion of a list, etc''': Do what you can, and other editors will do what they can. The strength of a wiki is its collaborative effort; with many hands doing the work, the entire task becomes easier for everyone.
